title: Taiwanese Student Association at NC State
content_html: The Taiwanese Student Association at NC State (NCSU TSA) is a student organization at North Carolina State University in Raleigh, North Carolina, serving the Taiwanese student community on campus. The organization maintains an active Instagram presence under the handle @tsaatncsu, where it has accumulated over 400 followers and more than 140 posts, and a Facebook group under the name “NC State TSA.” No dedicated website, Linktree, or publicly accessible GetInvolved directory listing with a mission statement could be confirmed through available first-party sources. NC State’s Office of Global Engagement has noted a consistent Taiwanese student population on campus, with students from Taiwan representing one of the university’s larger international student groups as of the mid-2010s, providing context for the organization’s community base.
